chains.name: Cart-double pendulum
chains.summary: Underactuated cart with two rotary links. One cart force swings both links upright and holds them. Hardware needs a fast MCU, joint-angle sensing through rotating shafts, and a cart-position encoder.

crypto.note: Buy via supplier carts for now. On-chain checkout is the next key.

parts.note: One per rotary joint so encoder and 3.3V lines do not twist off.
Absolute magnetic angle on shoulder and elbow.
Incremental quadrature for cart travel via belt or pinion.

components.name: Teensy 4.1
components.description: 600 MHz Cortex-M7 control brain. Hardware quadrature, SPI for magnetic encoders, and enough PWM/timers for a 1 kHz cart-pendulum loop.

suppliers.name: PJRC
suppliers.notes: Docs and pinouts. Direct store now redirects to SparkFun.

components.name: 12-wire capsule slip ring
components.description: Gold-plated rotating contacts so power and encoder signals can cross a spinning joint. Two needed: shoulder and elbow.

suppliers.name: Adafruit
suppliers.notes: 12mm capsule, 12 × 28 AWG. Compact for link joints.

suppliers.name: Adafruit
suppliers.notes: 22mm flanged 12-wire alternative if you need bolt-down mounting.

components.name: AS5047P magnetic rotary encoder
components.description: 14-bit absolute magnetic encoder for pendulum joint angle. No homing. SPI to the Teensy. Pair with a diametric magnet on each shaft.

suppliers.name: DigiKey

components.name: AMT102-V modular incremental encoder
components.description: Capacitive quadrature encoder for cart position. DIP-selectable PPR, sleeve kit for 2–8 mm shafts. Good on a belt idler or pinion.
